exercise.instruction: In main, declare int 'age' = 20. If age >= 18 and age < 65 print 'Adult'; else if age >= 65 print 'Senior'; else print 'Minor'.
hints: Hint 3: else if (age >= 65) std::cout << "Senior"; else std::cout << "Minor";
